title: incident-bot: add oncall quicklinks and SLO->runbook correlation helpers
author: Ava Patel
description: Adds oncall quicklinks to incident summaries and a small SLO->runbook correlation helper used by the SLO toolkit and incident-bot to surface relevant runbooks for alerts. Motivation: on recent outages engineers reported it took extra time to find runbooks relevant to an SLO breach; surfacing runbook links directly in the incident thread reduced time-to-action in our canary. This PR implements a mapping layer that links SLO meta tags to candidate runbooks, exposes a QuickLinks API used by the incident summary renderer, and wires the runbook suggestions into the on-call message payload. Changes are backwards-compatible: if no mapping exists, incident-bot falls back to the previous compact runbook link. Included: unit tests, integration test harness for quicklinks, docs update and migration script for existing runbook metadata. Checklist: 1) implement runbook mapper and cache, 2) add QuickLinks API + renderer changes, 3) add tests and CI, 4) update docs and migration guide, 5) staged rollout with feature flag. Rollout plan: enable behind feature flag for 10% of alerts for 48h, monitor oncall-reaction time and quicklink click-through using existing telemetry. No infra changes required; small memory caching added to incident-bot process. Requesting review from SRE and Docs for correctness and wording.
